children: Overview
UK investment trust's NAV per share rose 24.5% for year ended 30 June 2026
Company's NAV growth lagged benchmark Russell 2000, which gained 45.7%
Strategic Review ongoing after recent performance lagged benchmark by wide margin
Outlook
Company says macro environment remains supportive for US smaller companies
Board is conducting a Strategic Review, including potential cash exit for shareholders
Company highlights risks from interest rates, capex returns, and geopolitical tensions
Result Drivers
AI-DRIVEN MARKET - Co said benchmark returns were dominated by companies benefiting from investor enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and related technologies
QUALITY STRATEGY IMPACT - Co said its focus on quality companies was less in tune with market dynamics, contributing to performance lagging benchmark
M&A ACTIVITY - Co said elevated merger and acquisition activity among portfolio holdings reinforced conviction in underlying business value
